paragraphs.text:
Your  academic  standing  is  weighed.  A  rumor  circulates, 
suggesting  that  you  gained  your  position  at  Miskatonic  by 
falsifying records of your experience and qualifications. Since 
you have already embarrassed the institution enough, no formal 
investigation  is  made. You  are  politely  asked  to  tender  your 
resignation and are left with no choice but to comply.

Needless  to  say,  the  scandal  ends  your  serious  scientific 
career. For a while, you try to develop your theory in books 
and magazines, but the best journals ignore you. Writing for 
a popular, sensationalist market encourages sloppy work and 
exaggeration. It becomes harder and harder to take up your pen.
The Nadelmann Expedition is over. THE END.
